en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4205 - It is narrated from Hanan ibn Sadir who said:

"Fayd ibn Al-Mukhtar gifted a rabbit (al-rabitha) to Abu Abdullah (as). He brought it to him while I was present.
Imam (as) looked at it and said: "This has a shell (skin)," and Imam (as) ate from it while we were observing.
